description: Add a signature image (PNG or JPG) to a PDF page at a preset position along the bottom edge, scaled to a chosen width with proportional height. A simpler, signing-focused form of general image placement.

imagePath.description: Path to signature image (PNG or JPG)

page.description: Page to sign (1-indexed). Default: last page.

width.description: Signature width in points (default: 150). Height scales proportionally.

name: pdf_sign
